summary: {buyer} can still pursue a warranty claim after learning the hearing aid was legally sold over the counter.
realLife: Congress expressly preserved existing private remedies involving warranties, contracts, product liability and consumer protection when it created the retail category.
inGame: needs: warranty terms, sales records and private claims.

turns.writesBack: The constituent brings its terms and the receipt to a caseworker.
